name: Mall Cop Prime
title: Keeper of the Lost and Found
desc: A security guard who never clocked out. The food court is his kingdom.
flavor: He has confiscated four hundred and twelve skateboards and one soul.

phases.name: On Patrol
phases.text: He has seen you on camera seven.

phases.name: Segway Charge
phases.text: He found his wheels. Get out of the walkway.

phases.name: Code Red
phases.text: He called for backup. The backup is also him.

name: The Hungry Jukebox
title: Plays Requests. Eats Requesters.
desc: A chrome-and-neon jukebox that learned to walk on its cables.
flavor: Insert coin to continue. Insert crawler to skip the track.

phases.name: The Drop
phases.text: The bass hits. So does the jukebox.

name: The Lint Queen
title: Sovereign of Everything Under the Couch
desc: A towering monarch of dust, hair ties and one very old french fry.
flavor: Every coin you ever lost is in her crown.

phases.name: Royal Audience
phases.text: She permits you to approach. Briefly.

phases.name: Static Cling
phases.text: Your gear sticks to her. Your hope does not.

phases.name: Dust Storm
phases.text: The whole floor is under the couch now.
